Overview

Puerto Cortés is a city in CR with a population of 120,000. Honduras’s most important Caribbean port, a bustling shipping hub with beautiful nearby beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
